interpretationLimits: Supported response modes are engineering evidence, not calibrated probabilities or native physical tangent truth.
Four distinct observed pixels can be hair, liner, fold or skin texture and do not establish terminal absence.
Restoration on ambiguous controls is not a measured false-positive rate, but it prevents a safe adoption claim.
No renderer authorized by purely expanded reach; physically convincing root/terminal ownership and protected controls remain unmet.
